description: Does a part fit a given antenna model? Give sku or product_id, plus antenna_model. Answers from catalog fitment data only: true or false when the part has model-level fitment data, "unknown" when it has none or is fitted only at series level. An unrecognised model, or a brand or series name, returns an error instead of an answer.

antenna_model.description: One antenna model, name or slug, e.g. v100NX or v60E. Case and spacing are ignored.

product_id.description: Catalog product id. Give this or sku.

sku.description: Part number. Give this or product_id.

name: check_compatibility
title: Check compatibility
